# Remotion Multimedia

A compact reference for Mediabunny, the multimedia library for audio and video in the browser: three companion guides show how to get an audio file's duration, a video file's dimensions, and a video file's duration with the Mediabunny Input API, from a URL, a Remotion staticFile(), a local file path or a Blob. It works locally in the user's own project (browser, Node.js or Bun); no licence was found anywhere in the upstream repository at the pinned commit — see the licence note on this listing. Curated by Skill Harbor — Remotion Multimedia, by @remotion-dev, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
